label: D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S2 by a common transition
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2), and only when the inputs show last action a2 and reached state S2, i.e. a common a2->S2 transition. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, or on rare transitions (a2->S1). The predicate catches every activation on dev (recall 1.0, mass recall 1.0), but only about 37% of a2->S2 D2 steps are active, so precision is the weak part. Activity on those steps rises with episode position: the rate climbs steadily over trials and ep_trial>=50 holds about 80% of the mass. It is also higher when S2 is actually the good state (good==2 holds 77% of the mass, and good==1 only 6%). The strongest activations (0.8-1.0) come on the first or second a2->S2 trial after a1 choices or rare transitions. In long uninterrupted a2->S2c runs it gets weak or goes silent. Adding conditions for late-episode position or the good state (best F1 0.63) or for a2-run novelty did not give a clean predicate, so the simple observed-input predicate is the one recorded. All variables are observed at D2.
